responseWindow.prompt: Which settlement architecture should receive your support?

options.label: Centralized Security Compact
options.description: Create stronger common verification/security authority with larger control and liberty costs.

options.label: Multilateral Reconstruction
options.description: Use distributed oversight, audit, shared repair finance, and slower common institutions.

options.label: Regional Corridor System
options.description: Build smaller interoperable route blocs with more redundancy and transaction cost.

options.label: Managed Meridian Suspension
options.description: Freeze the original integration plan and stabilize through bilateral or temporary arrangements.

news.title: Belonging and accountability collide in every adopted country
news.summary: Residency, service, disclosure, travel, and public trust are being reconsidered through different national institutions. In Xalvoria, the immediate lens is infrastructure finance, capital, project management, leverage, and displacement.

news.title: Belonging and accountability collide in every adopted country
news.summary: Residency, service, disclosure, travel, and public trust are being reconsidered through different national institutions. In Dravenlok, the immediate lens is steel, rail equipment, machinery, industrial output, and worker safety.

news.title: Belonging and accountability collide in every adopted country
news.summary: Residency, service, disclosure, travel, and public trust are being reconsidered through different national institutions. In Syndalis, the immediate lens is cybersecurity, payment verification, data infrastructure, privacy, and due process.

news.title: Foreign-born residents face enhanced status and security reviews
news.summary: Governments preparing for settlement negotiations tighten selected reviews while public debate turns to loyalty, due process, and permanent belonging.

news.title: Four settlement architectures enter formal negotiation
news.summary: Negotiators compare a centralized security compact, multilateral reconstruction, regional corridors, and managed Meridian suspension.

news.title: Negotiators publish costs and safeguards for four settlement models
news.summary: The proposals are now detailed enough to compare authority, audit, speed, redundancy, ownership, and economic cost.
